method: Blind solve recorded from the blind file only, before opening the question file.

solves.a: The man is Bartolome de las Casas, the Dominican friar the caption names Bishop of Chiapa and 'defender of the Indians.'
solves.b: Las Casas campaigned against Spanish cruelty toward Native peoples and for Crown protection of them; his writings helped push the Crown to pass the New Laws of 1542, which limited the encomienda and forbade new grants of Native labor.
solves.c: The engraving was made in 1791, about 225 years after Las Casas died (he died in 1566), so it is an idealized imagining made long after his lifetime, not a portrait drawn from life. It shows how later generations remembered him, not what he looked like.
